article.title: macOS Golden Gate: Steinberg Product Compatibility
article.body:
On September 15, 2026, Apple released macOS Golden Gate (macOS 27), the successor to macOS Tahoe (macOS 26).

If you rely on your Steinberg software and hardware to run smoothly, we recommend that you refrain from updating to macOS Golden Gate for now.

A compatibility chart for relevant Steinberg products will be available as soon as we have the initial test results.
